story: Matt Gallagher and Evan Shuman opened Assembly in downtown Hingham in early 2018, at 24 North Street, selling men's and women's clothing with art, gifts and home goods. Per the Hingham Anchor of May 2021, Assembly then opened in Cohasset in June 2020 and at Duxbury Marketplace in May 2021. Boston Magazine named it Best Boutique, South, in its 2021 Best of Boston. The shop now keeps separate doors, ASSEMBLY His at 24 North Street and ASSEMBLY Hers at 88 North Street, where the homegoods shop holly & olive moved in next door in spring 2026. Its Designers page lists 16 labels, among them Citizens of Humanity, AGOLDE and Save Khaki United.
note: 88 North St. is ASSEMBLY Hers (women's); the men's door is ASSEMBLY His, 24 North St., Hingham MA 02043 - brand pages' single door is the Hers door; site ZIP 02043 fills the gap on the brand pages.
